description: webhooks/<name>.yaml: an authenticated ingress URL for JSON POST requests.

authMode.description: How the sender authenticates: token (the secret in an Authorization: Bearer header), url_token (the secret as the last segment of the URL path) or signature (a provider signature). It cannot change after the first apply.

deliveryIdHeader.description: Request header that holds the delivery ID. Open Factory uses the ID to find repeated deliveries. It must not be a credential header, for example Authorization, Cookie or a signature header. Stored in canonical form.

enabled.description: If false, the webhook never starts an automation.

signatureScheme.description: Signature format of the provider. Required when authMode is signature, and allowed only then. It cannot change after the first apply.

title: Webhook
